gold: FIP1L1-PDGFRA–positive chronic eosinophilic leukemia (CEL) with associated generalized eruptive histiocytosis (GEH)

selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of hypereosinophilia, elevated tryptase, and skin lesions is most consistent with Hypereosinophilic syndrome, which is further supported by the presence of the FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene.

rejected.label: Chronic Eosinophilic Leukemia
rejected.why: While the patient has hypereosinophilia, the presence of the FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene and the clinical presentation are more consistent with Hypereosinophilic syndrome.

rejected.label: Histiocytosis
rejected.why: The skin biopsy showed nodular infiltration of histiocytes, but the clinical and laboratory findings are not typical for Histiocytosis.

rejected.label: Eosinophilic dermatosis
rejected.why: The patient's skin lesions are part of a broader systemic disease, making Eosinophilic dermatosis a less likely diagnosis.
